title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
content:
OrderFlow Shipping Policy:
1. Delivery Times: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days across India. Express shipping delivers within 24 to 48 hours in metro cities.
2. Shipping Charges: Free shipping is automatically applied to all orders with a total above ₹10,000. Orders below ₹10,000 incur a flat ₹200 fee.
3. Order Tracking: As soon as an order is 'Confirmed', real-time tracking is assigned and visible in the portal.
4. Damaged in Transit: If a package is visibly damaged upon delivery, please refuse delivery and contact customer support immediately.

title: Cancellation & Order Modification
content:
OrderFlow Cancellation & Modification Terms:
1. Pending Orders: Orders in 'Pending' status can be cancelled immediately from the portal or assistant without charge.
2. Confirmed Orders: Once an order reaches 'Confirmed' status, cancellation requests must be submitted within 2 hours.
3. Payment Failures: If a payment attempt fails ('PaymentFailed' status), the order is automatically marked cancelled and any reserved inventory is immediately released back to available stock via Saga compensation.
